mapper.insert: insert into project_abandon_records (project_id, leader_account_id, reason, previous_status, departure_at, abandoned_at) values (#{projectId}, #{leaderAccountId}, #{reason}, #{previousStatus}, #{departureAt}, #{abandonedAt})
mapper.select: select id, project_id, leader_account_id, reason, previous_status, departure_at, abandoned_at, created_at from project_abandon_records where project_id = #{projectId} order by abandoned_at desc, id desc
